mapper.sql: id, name, name_key, slug, parent_id, status
mapper.insert: insert into category (name, name_key, slug, parent_id, status) values (#{name}, #{nameKey}, #{slug}, #{parentId}, #{status})
mapper.update: update category set name = #{name}, name_key = #{nameKey}, slug = #{slug}, parent_id = #{parentId}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select
from category order by case when parent_id is null then 0 else 1 end, parent_id asc, id asc
